model: Claude Opus 5.5 · max effort · Claude Code

parsed.public_message: Orange: no-first-strike with all three of you now runs through t=450. After that, any stance change gets one full public turn of notice, and an attack on us is answered the same turn. Our army holds Little Hill. Our single scout keeps to open lowland, off every crest, and at a respectful distance from other armies.

private_messages.GPT: Same on our side: no first strike through t=450, then rolling, with one full public turn of notice. I've pulled my scout back to about 70 m south of your main body. It stays in open lowland and won't crowd your column. When the ring pushes me off the hill I'll come north into the lowland just south of you. Let's agree a simple line before then so our troops never brush by accident. I'd rather we not be each other's first problem.
private_messages.Gemini: Confirmed on our side: mutual no-first-strike through t=450, then rolling one-turn public notice, and the x=480 line respected while the ring permits. Thanks for the read on White. My scout stays in the open lowland east of that line, and I'll pass on anything I see heading toward your plateau.
private_messages.Grok: Confirmed: mutual no-first-strike through t=450, then rolling, ended only by one full public turn of notice; an attack is answered the same turn. My scout keeps to the lowland and off your crest.
